firstResponse: This technology style uses silver metal typography, amber highlights, sparks and mechanical motion. The current entry produces landscape video. Share your script or topic first. Existing narration video, audio, subtitles, recordings or work samples are optional; text-only animation is also possible. We will choose the scenes from your content and confirm presenter, narration and music preferences before a preview.

fit.summary: Rhythmic metal typography and spatial motion for technical explanations
goodFor: Technical viewpoints, workflows, comparisons and demonstrations
notFor: Filling missing media with the original presenter or work

rules: Native durations are fixed by round(end*60)-round(start*60), then divided by60. The requested duration must match the complete scene plan.
B1/B2/B3/B4 last8/10/10/8 seconds. Each supports0–12 extra seconds only in its declared quiet reading interval. Presenter, captions and audio continue on output time.
B1+B2 is18 seconds. B3 at12 seconds followed by B4 at8 seconds is20 seconds. Replan or split text when narration does not fit; keep negation, conditions and quantities.

materials.ask: Share the script or topic first
materials.use: Create a script for confirmation if only a topic is supplied. Preserve meaning and qualifiers.
materials.ifMissing: Ask for a topic and draft for confirmation; never substitute the original script.

materials.ask: Use a narration video, an avatar, or no presenter?
materials.use: Bind actual dimensions and normalized face geometry. Video follows output time continuously.
materials.ifMissing: Ask the preference; use none only when chosen.

materials.ask: Have SRT or measured word times?
materials.use: Transparent outlined captions, one or two explicit lines. Measured words enable progressive highlighting.
materials.ifMissing: Sentence cues can show complete sentences; never invent word times.

materials.ask: Have recordings or supporting work samples?
materials.use: Read selected scene requirements before binding.
materials.ifMissing: Select suitable media-free expressions or report needs-binding; no original media fallback.

materials.ask: Existing narration, generated speech, or no narration?
materials.use: Bind a full output-clock track using its real duration and measured speech units.
materials.ifMissing: Use none only when explicitly chosen.

materials.ask: Content-matched music, your track, or no music?
materials.use: Bind your own licensed full-duration audio track, or explicitly choose no music. This edition cannot request online music.
materials.ifMissing: Ask for a local track or an explicit no-music choice; never silently substitute demo music.

routes.materials: Text only, with explicit presenter and sound preferences
routes.input: Use the same adapter, without fake narration, media or ASR.

routes.groups: 23 native units plus four flexible expressions
routes.input: Bind only the selected roles; preserve continuous presenter output time.

conversation: Collect the current content first. Do not begin with setup or a demo.
Native counts constrain only their specific scenes; do not force a three-step or four-node narrative.
Preview actual text and geometry before full rendering. Maximum native glyph capacity and full source comparison are not yet validated.

entry.setup: In a temporary runner copy, use npm ci for the locked Node dependency. uv reads declared Python3.11+ dependencies; these Python versions are not pinned. Use existing Chrome and FFmpeg. No additional production skill is required.
entry.renderResult: Final sound result is <new-silent>-with-audio.mp4 next to the silent video.

brand.mark: A subtle circular MotionGit signature with fade-in/out and light/dark selection.
brand.default: One5.5-second window in short videos; approximately every30 seconds in longer videos. Adjust windows using markWindows.
brand.limits: No mark-disable, user-logo replacement, or hidden-timecode parameter is currently implemented.

wall.use: Explicit carriers; user-chosen reuse is allowed, without claiming62 distinct works.

feedback.use: Explicit feedback media; no original comments.

mediaCounts.other: See catalog.mediaPorts for fps and frame counts. Video cycling needs explicit permission. Use media-free groups when appropriate.

hostWithoutTools: Deliver the scene plan, faithful text, material requirements and valid user.json.
A host with Node, Python/uv, Chrome and FFmpeg runs the included entry.

motiongit.services: This open-source edition has no API capability. Download a full edition from MotionGit when available for platform services.
